summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) filed a Form 6-K on May 28, 2026, announcing quarterly dividends declared by its Board of Directors. The filing details a common share dividend of $1.07 per share payable July 28, 2026, to shareholders of record June 29, 2026, along with preferred share dividends. This is a routine dividend declaration by a foreign private issuer, not a special situation event. There are no terms, premiums, advisors, or structural mechanics applicable. The filing serves as an ordinary periodic report, with no activist, strategic, or transactional dynamics present.
